summary.intent: Run Session 2 of the v1-alpha launch plan: implement WP D (callisto init branch/workflow boundary fixes, findings F04/F05/F09), then continue to WP J and L. Mid-session the lead added follow-ups on PR #565: untrack mutants.out.old, fix placeholder re-expansion, and reject unsupported artifact owners on the workflow-only retry path.
summary.outcome: WP D was implemented (BranchName type, WorkflowScalar quoting, new `init --workflow` retry path), reviewed, mutation-tested, gated green, and pushed as PR #565 on trail #357. The lead's follow-ups (a)-(c) were committed locally, but the rebase, re-gate, push/ls-remote check, finding resolution, and the J and L work are not done.

repo: Branch handling in init previously took the last `/` segment of a ref (`last_ref_segment`), truncating `release/next` to `next`; now replaced by `BranchName::from_full_ref` / `from_remote_ref` in callisto-model `identity.rs`, re-exported by glob.
Generated workflow branch values are always JSON-double-quoted, and `+`/`!` are escaped in trigger filters via `WorkflowScalar::branch_filter`; tests assert the quoted form (`branch: \"main\"`).
callisto-model has its own `Version` type, so callisto-cli should not add a semver dependency.
CLI init tests live in `crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/init/tests.rs`; graph init tests in `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init/tests.rs`.
Repo gate is `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test`; an architecture test (`apply_permits_are_never_granted_from_a_literal`) failed once and needed a fix in cli init.rs.
Changesets are added via `./target/debug/callisto add --package cargo/callisto-cli:patch --summary ...`.
`commands/matrix.rs` (~line 58) drops artifacts with non-Cargo owners, so a workflow generated for an npm-owned artifact fails at release with 'callisto matrix has no entry for artifact slot'.
Adversarial audit findings (F04, F05, F09) live in /tmp/callisto-adversarial-audit-2026-11-17/report.md; docs/research JSONs are untracked in the main checkout.
Trail workflow: `entire trail link 357 --base main` and `entire trail ci-pr`; commits must be signed, no session trailer, pushed with an explicit refspec and verified with `git ls-remote`.

code.finding: `run_workflow_only` originally always built `InitReport { initialized: false }`, so a real write printed '[DRY-RUN] Would write' (render/mod.rs:131-136); the reviewer caught this and it was fixed.

`detect_initialized`/`detect_facts` re-synthesized a config and re-ran tag-template detection, ignoring the user's existing callisto.toml (E193/E194 false failures); reworked to read the user's own config.

workflow: A subagent reviewing from source only (no build) still found four real defects; running it concurrently with cargo mutants meant edits had to wait since both use the same worktree.
Mutation runs with `--in-diff` on a diff file surfaced missed mutants that drove additional tests.
BSD sed on macOS failed with `\"` escapes and `-i` syntax; the Edit tool or Python scripts run with `-I` were more reliable.
Setting CARGO_PROFILE_*_DEBUG=0 and limiting CARGO_BUILD_JOBS kept parallel worktree builds manageable; deleting a worktree's `target` after finishing frees space.

friction: A worktree-entry/relocation prompt stopped the session; the lead had to resume it and asked to use EnterWorktree name= rather than path=.
BSD sed incompatibilities forced redoing several quoted-branch test replacements.
Repeated duplicate bash calls and failed grep attempts when locating files (e.g. F09 in untracked research JSONs, CLI init test location).
The final `git rebase origin/worktree-wp-d-init-boundary` output was not examined, so the rebase state is unverified.
open_items: Confirm the rebase succeeded, then re-run just pre-push, lint, doc-check and test by exit code on #565.
Push the new commits with an explicit refspec, verify with `git ls-remote`, and resolve both Entire findings on callisto/173 with `entire trail finding`.
Item (c) reused existing error E304 for unsupported artifact owners; the lead said to ask before adding a new code, so confirm that fit.
Work packages J (twine env isolation, worktree wp-j-twine-env prepared) and L remain, with trail linking to #459.
Changeset wording was to say every `+`/`!` is escaped; verify it was updated.
No GitHub issues were created for the trail guidance (D→#357, L and J→#459).
